name: Postman Echo
description:
Sends back whatever you send it: query params, headers, body and form fields.

Use it to check exactly what Pixapie is sending, for example that a header or Content-Type is set the way you expect.

requests.name: Echo query params
requests.description: Your params come back under "args". Add, change or switch off params and send again.

params.description: Any name and value you like
Any name and value you like

requests.name: Echo a JSON body
requests.description: Your JSON comes back under "data" (and "json"), with the headers that were sent.

requests.name: Echo form fields
requests.description: Sends a URL-encoded form. The fields come back under "form".

requests.name: Echo headers
requests.description: Returns every header it received, including the ones added for you.

requests.name: Get a status code
requests.description: Responds with the status code at the end of the URL. Change 404 to any code to see how it looks.

requests.name: Slow response
requests.description: Waits the number of seconds at the end of the URL (up to 10) before answering. Good for checking the TIME shown.

requests.name: Basic auth
requests.description: Checks a Basic auth header. The value is "postman:password" encoded in base64. Switch the header off to see a 401.
